PETREX GMBH is a Germany-based chemical company located at Wachtendonker Straße 11, D‑47906 Kempen. Positioned in North Rhine‑Westphalia—one of Europe’s most established industrial and logistics regions—PETREX GMBH is part of a landscape known for strong technical expertise, reliable supply chains, and close collaboration between industry and research. From its Kempen site, the company supports customers that depend on consistent product quality, dependable delivery, and clear technical communication—core expectations in modern chemical markets.

As a chemical company, PETREX GMBH operates in a sector where performance and compliance go hand in hand. Typical priorities for companies in this field include robust quality management, careful handling and storage of chemical materials, and adherence to applicable European and German regulations governing safety, transport, labeling, and environmental stewardship. Just as important is responsiveness: customers often require tailored solutions, documentation support, and product continuity across changing market conditions.

With its presence in Kempen, PETREX GMBH is well placed to serve both domestic and international partners, benefiting from proximity to major industrial hubs and transport routes in the Rhine‑Ruhr region and beyond. Overall, PETREX GMBH represents a committed chemical-industry partner focused on professionalism, operational reliability, and long-term customer relationships.
